svg.text: VeltrixQuant Footprint Pro (#17) — Technical Architecture Flowchart
Hybrid History Without Mandatory Heavy Tick Replay · Lock-Free Tick Aggregation · Direct2D GPU LOD Batcher · Cross-Chart Hub
STAGE 1 · DUAL DATA INGESTION (NO MANDATORY FULL-CHART TICK REPLAY)
1A. Hybrid Historical Seeder (Light Mode)
• Loads internal 1-Tick / 1-Minute CME volume series
• Instant load on NQ 20 Range / 30m WITHOUT freeze
• Optional: Tick Replay = ON enables 100% raw tape history
Default: MaxBarsLookBack 256+ · Zero full-chart hang
1B. Live 0ms Tape + Depth Feeds (Realtime)
• OnMarketData(Last): exact Price, Volume, BestBid, BestAsk
• OnMarketDepth(L2): resting liquidity & pull/replenish
• Reconstruct Tape Engine: merges split prints < 10ms
Supports Tradovate (10-lvl L2) + Rithmic (MBO/Full)
1C. Ecosystem Sync Bridges (Read-Only)
• Reads VeltrixTpoCrossChartHub (#16 VAH/VAL/POC)
• Reads NiveisGammaPro Walls (Call/Put/Flip strikes)
• Reads Watchdog / Heatmap Bubble offset config
Zero duplicate math — clean shared memory hub
STAGE 2 · ORDERFLOW CLASSIFICATION & O(1) LOCK-FREE CLUSTER AGGREGATOR
2A. Trade Classification & Tape Recon
• Mode: BidAsk | UpDownTick | Hybrid
• Spread: Split 50/50 | Ignore | TickRule
• Filters: Ticks/lvl, Trade min/max (-1)
2B. BarClusterStore (Zero GC Pause)
• Int Tick -> BidVol, AskVol, Trades, Max
• O(1) BarDelta, CumDelta, COT H/L, Min/Max
• Dynamic LOD: merges N ticks on zoom out
2C. Microstructure Analytics Engines
• Diag/Horiz Imbalance % + Stacked S/R
• True L2 Absorption (Tape + DOM Reload)
• Unfinished Auction, Ratio, Delta Traps
STAGE 3 · DIRECT2D GPU BATCH RENDERER (60+ FPS · VISIBLE VIEWPORT CULLING)
3A. Direct2D Viewport-Only Batched Painter
• Loops ONLY ChartBars.FromIndex .. ToIndex (culls offscreen)
• Pre-built Brushes + TextFormats in OnRenderTargetChanged
• Renders: Left/Right Footprint · Body · Bar VPOC/VA Box
• Smart LOD Switch: numbers hide cleanly < 28px bar width
• Lateral Bubble Lane prevents Heatmap bubble occlusion
Draws Bar Statistic + Docked Statistic Grid aligned to bar X
3B. Topbar Popup (Footprint) + Essential Alerts
• 1-Click Presets: NQ Scalp (4t) | ES Standard (1t) | Trap
• Hot-swap Left/Right Style, Ticks/level, Imbalance %, Colors
• 4 High-Signal Alerts (Stacked Imb, L2 Abs, Unfin, Div)
• Persistent JSON/XML state across F5 & NT8 Restart
Zero Hardware ID / DRM polling -- 100% native compiled speed
Optional Chart Trader confluence highlight near Gamma Walls
CPU & Frame-Time Budget Target (NQ Open 09:30 ET):
• Tick: < 0.02ms/print (zero LINQ) | Frame Render: < 4ms GPU Direct2D | History Load: < 1.2s (Hybrid 1m)
Eliminates GDI+ locks, 30+ redundant .wav audio slots, and mandatory 20-day full Tick Replay RAM spikes.
